Hi Liam —

Thanks again for locking in Tuesday's demo. A quick update from your side: you mentioned Governance is adding Security and Procurement to the review list (great — we definitely want them in scope). Given those additions, and a couple of known travel conflicts on your side, we think the session should expand to a 75–90 minute consolidated run-through so we can cover the technical architecture overview + security posture + procurement terms without rushing.

Attached is a proposed agenda (Proposed_Agenda.xlsx) that maps sections and owner names. Can you confirm whether a 90-minute slot works and share any absolute blackout dates for the next two weeks? If helpful, we can also break into a two-part run-through (security+infra deep-dive + product flow) but prefer a single consolidated session for continuity.

If the ask is to include someone from CloudBridge (your SSO / infra partner), please introduce them and we will invite the relevant internal SMEs.

Next steps I suggest:
- You confirm availability window / absolute no-go dates
- We lock a 90-min calendar slot and send an invite with prep docs
- Marcus will lead the security/infra segment; Vivek will cover deployment/SLAs and routing policies

Apologies for the short notice — want to make sure we give your extended panel the time they need.

Thanks,
